title: A Mallows-Centered Latent Ordering Model for the Partial Ordering Continual Reassessment Method in Drug-Combination Trials
abstract: The Partial Ordering Continual Reassessment Method (POCRM) is a model-based design for Phase I clinical trials when the toxicity ordering of treatment combinations is only partially known. POCRM extends the CRM skeleton power model framework by considering multiple plausible toxicity orderings of the treatment combinations.
